heading: Historical collections
lead: The Regents of the Smithsonian Institution may allow the corporation to deposit its collections, manuscripts, books, pamphlets, and other historical material in the Smithsonian Institution or the National Museum on conditions and under regulations the Regents prescribe.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2130636:20 (last sentence).Jan. 4, 1889, ch. 20, (last sentence), 25 Stat. 640. The words “historical material” are substituted for “material for history” for clarity. The words “at their discretion” are omitted as unnecessary.
